description: Opus DD unit B27: Golisopod (Emergency Exit, 76/150 HP) Head Smashes Chansey (Eject Button; Harden first). In Champions' hit loop the recoil comes before AfterMoveSecondary: the recoil knocks Golisopod out and Emergency Exit flags it (no HP guard), so Chansey's Eject Button sees Golisopod's `switchFlag === true` through `getAllActive()` (its faint is not processed yet) and stays unused. Showdown then asks p1 to replace the fainted Golisopod mid-turn (Hariyama) before Snorlax moves; p2 is never asked. A crit knocks Chansey out too; a miss (80% accuracy) does nothing.
